releases.name: My Lovey-Dovey Demon
releases.summary: A cute love story between a young man and an affectionate, adoring, utterly insatiable demon girl set in the Japanese countryside.

releases.name: HORSE CLUB Ride West
releases.summary: The HORSE CLUB is visiting the Wild River Ranch! Travel with your friends Hannah, Sofia, Sarah, and Lisa to the Wild West. Explore the vast landscape, help old and new friends, experience exciting adventures on horseback, and win the crown at the Western riding tournament!

releases.name: Banchou Tactics: Lion Heart
releases.summary:
Itsara Amata x Corecell presents Banchou Tactics: Lion Heart, an indie action tactical RPG set in the fierce world of rival Japanese delinquent schools.

The game blends tactical decision-making with dynamic action-timing combat. Plan your moves, position your allies, and master the timing of punches, kicks, guards, counters, and special attacks to win each battle.

Players will fight alongside memorable allies, challenge rival schools, and rise through the ranks in a story of friendship, pride, and the drive to become the strongest.

One school. One rule. Prove you're the strongest.

releases.name: Sesame Street: Friends & Fun
releases.summary:
Welcome to Sesame Street! A place to play, laugh and grow.

From the moment you arrive, there’s so much to do. Join Elmo, Tango and the rest of your Sesame Street friends around the neighbourhood!

Walk around with Grover, plant a magical giant beanstalk in Abby’s Garden, find useful tools and rubber ducks in the Community Garden with Bert & Ernie, and work on your number and puzzle skills in Count von Count’s Mansion. Or cook, mix and laugh along with Cookie Monster in his Foodie Truck! Some quests may take a few tries, but you’ll work together to find a way to make the streets a brighter and happier place for everyone.

Make yourself at home! Decorate your house, unlock new mini-games, access exciting new areas of the Street, or throw and unforgettable block party. Spend time with Tango, your cheerful and furry helper or enjoy the whole adventure together with family and friends in local co-op play.

The fun and exploration never ends on Sesame Street!

JOIN THE NEIGHBORHOOD: Create your own character and join Elmo, Tango, Abby and their friends on Sesame Street.

EXPLORE THE STREET: Start at your apartment, stop by Big Bird’s cozy nest, play at the Count’s Mansion, and unlock more places.

BRING EVERYONE TOGETHER: Help the community by going on cooking, photography, and even farming quests solo or in co-op.

DISCOVER AND GROW: Use rewards to decorate your home, unlock new mini-games and access exciting new areas.

TRAVEL WITH TANGO: Take care of Tango just like she’ll take care of you as she helps you get around.

releases.name: Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen
releases.summary:
Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen enriches the dynamic fantasy world and expansive adventures of Dragon's Dogma 2 with unforgettable new tales and thrilling encounters.
    Based on feedback we received after the initial release of Dragon's Dogma 2, we established three goals for ourselves when we set out to update and expand the game:
    Enhanced gameplay. Expanded adventures. Enticing value.

releases.name: Curse of Baghdad
releases.summary: A top-down military shooter with a rich story about brotherhood when surviving an unknown curse. Face the odds and escape with your life from this unprecedented threat that lurks in the shadows of Baghdad, Iraq.

releases.name: Dungeons & Degenerate Gamblers
releases.summary: Battle your way through a seedy tavern filled with gambling addicted townspeople in this Blackjack Roguelike Adventure. From aces and face cards to tarot cards, business cards and more, create your unique deck to beat the house.

releases.name: X-Force Genesis 2
releases.summary: X-Force Genesis 2The chaos is back in space!Get ready for a frantic and challenging shmup experience inspired by the classic space shooters of the 80s and 90s.Pilot your ship through 12 intense stages, face waves of enemies, dodge hundreds of projectiles, and take on gigantic bosses in explosive battles.Every second will test your reflexes, strategy, and skills. Dodge, attack, upgrade your ship, and survive the chaos!FRANTIC ACTIONFace dozens of enemies simultaneously as a relentless storm of projectiles fills the screen.Keep moving, find gaps between the attacks, and survive increasingly difficult attack patterns.CHOOSE YOUR SHIPChoose from different ships, each with unique characteristics and attributes.Find the ship that best matches your playstyle and take advantage of its strengths to overcome the challenges of each stage.BOSS BATTLESGigantic enemies await at the end of the stages.Face enormous bosses, learn their attack patterns, dodge their projectiles, and find the perfect moment to strike.The farther you go, the more dangerous the challenges become.UPGRADE YOUR SHIPStrengthen your ship throughout your journey and prepare to face increasingly powerful enemies.Use upgrades and Power-ups to increase your firepower and turn your ship into a true destruction machine.FEATURES* 12 stages packed with action and challenges.* Various enemies with different attack patterns.* Hundreds of projectiles on screen at the same time.* Gigantic and challenging bosses.* Different ships to choose from.* Upgrades to increase your ship's power.* Power-ups to turn the tide in critical moments.* Comets and other hazards to avoid throughout the stages.* An experience inspired by classic shmups from the 80s and 90s.* An intense action campaign that puts your reflexes to the test.Prepare your ship. Face the chaos. Survive the battle.X-Force Genesis 2 is waiting for you.

releases.name: Sugar Rush Rescue
releases.summary:
A tasty, retro co-op adventure.

When best friends Colby and Jack find a forest of candy, they're ready to munch! But while the boys selfishly sample the sweets, Colby's little sister is abducted by a monstrous owl! Now they must navigate a world of confections as they learn to pay attention to what matters most.

Featuring a wide range of obstacles, enemies, and levels to explore, Sugar Rush Rescue is a tasty, retro co-op adventure.

releases.name: BANCHOU TACTICS
releases.summary:
For several years of conflicts, there were bloody struggles between three high schools around this area (somewhere in Japan). This madness played by the three schools: Sakae High School, Nakamura Technical High School and Minato High School. They engaged in many fierce battles with the aim to show who's boss in this town.

When Kitagawa Seiichi, the demon king of Minato High School just graduated last year, all the balance of three power came to doubt once again.

Banchou Tactics is a strategy turn based role-playing game in the Japanese Gangster High School (Banchou). Game inspire by Crows (Japanese Manga) River City Ransom and Final Fantasy Tactics.

releases.name: Rhythm Roll
releases.summary: Roll through a world of rhythm and light in Rhythm Roll! Control a fast-moving ball through stunning levels, each with its own unique visual style and musical genre. Dodge obstacles, stay on the beat, and test your reflexes. Simple to play, but can you master the speed?

releases.name: Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival
releases.summary:
Experience a new chapter in the legendary horror series like never before. Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival takes first-person action horror survival to the next level.

Play the story of Aidan, who must use the power of a mysterious puzzle box – the Genesis Configuration – to help his girlfriend Sunny's escape from the otherworldly hellscape of the Labyrinth.

Wield the powers of the box to survive your bargain with the infamous Pinhead and do battle with the horrific cult devoted to the Cenobites.

A New Story in Hellraiser's Canon – Unwittingly kickstart Pinhead’s ritual to unleash greater pain and pleasure than ever before.

Harness the Power of the Box – Combine the unique, hellish abilities of the Configuration with an arsenal of earthly weapons to inflict bone-breaking, flesh-searing pain - or is it pleasure? - upon masochistic enemies.

Fight Against Unholy Enemies – Take on hell's wretches, deviants, cultists, and even its most infernal priests in a story-driven horror survival game.

releases.name: Silver Pines
releases.summary:
Private investigator Red Walker finds himself in Silver Pines, a place half-abandoned, half-forgotten, in the middle of nowhere on a job to track down Eddie Velvet. A musician who has vanished. As the case begins to reveal a dark past, Walker soon slips into a strange and nightmarish descent beyond his control.

Silver Pines is a survival horror metroidvania set in small town America. Fight nightmarish terrors and solve puzzles, while carefully managing your scarce resources as you uncover the mysteries that could hold the key to redemption.

releases.name: Deck of Haunts
releases.summary:
Step into the role of a sinister Haunted House, where the walls whisper secrets and terror lurks around every corner. As the master of this cursed domain, your goal is to ensnare daring humans, play on their fears, and drain their very essence to expand your dark influence.

By day, meticulously design the labyrinthine layout of your mansion, transforming it into a death trap that no human can escape. As night falls, lure unwitting explorers into your home, where you'll use a deck of terrifying cards to summon spirits, shift hallways, and unleash spine-chilling horrors. Build tension and drive your guests toward madness, all while protecting your Heart room - the core of your malevolent power.

Once their sanity crumbles, harvest their essence to strengthen your mansion, increasing your infamy and attracting even more daring foes, from law enforcement to priests. But beware, the Stone Masons are coming, ready to challenge your reign of terror...

releases.name: Gear.Club Unlimited 3
releases.summary:
Having attracted millions of players for nearly 10 years, the Gear.Club series finally returns with Gear.Club Unlimited 3! For the first time in the series, you can now explore the asphalt roads of Japan as well as the French Mediterranean coast. 

Drive over 40 prestigious cars from the biggest automotive brands and customize every detail: paint, bodywork, rims, mechanical performance… Create a car that reflects your individuality and show off your style on a wide range of spectacular race tracks.

Each car has been recreated with extreme accuracy: cockpit, engine, bodywork... The incredible attention to detail is visually stunning. It's then up to you to customize your cars so you can dominate the track with a car that reflects your individuality.

Get ready for the most intense and most immersive racing experience of the series: victory, style and adrenaline are in your hands.

releases.name: Echo Weaver
releases.summary:
Echo Weaver is a time loop metroidBRAINia where time is your best resource and secrets are your only upgrades. 

You're the last of the Weavers, a remnant of a ruined society trapped in a glitching time loop. The Congregation set out to explore the stars and find paradise. What they found instead has led their utopian project to ash and cinders.

Can you master time itself to unravel the conspiracy at the heart of Provenance?

releases.name: Order of the Sinking Star
releases.summary:
From legendary director Jonathan Blow (Braid, The Witness) comes Order of the Sinking Star, a massive narrative adventure featuring more than one thousand hand-crafted puzzles designed to put your intellect to the test. 

As Queen Effia, you are transported to a realm of curious magic, dangerous contraptions, and vicious monsters. As you make your way, you will explore four distinct worlds, each with its own mechanics, characters, and stories, and then watch as they all collide.

As the worlds merge, and characters meet one another, puzzle systems intertwine, creating surprising new gameplay possibilities. Explore at your own pace, revisit worlds and return to challenges as you see fit. Discover unique playable characters, master evolving gameplay mechanics, and decipher the deep mysteries of a sprawling, interconnected game world. 

Blending exploration, storytelling, and ever-progressing mechanics, Order of the Sinking Star invites you into a mysterious, living puzzle unlike anything you've played.

releases.name: Neon Abyss 2
releases.summary:
Dive deeper into the chaotic, beautifully pixelated Abyss with Neon Abyss 2! The action is faster, the stakes are higher, and the possibilities are endless in this cybermyth roguelike.

With explosive run 'n' gun gameplay, diverse combat styles, and unlimited item synergies, Neon Abyss 2 delivers a dramatic, thrill-packed experience every time you enter.

releases.name: Hidden Dogs
releases.summary:
ワンちゃんたちの村へようこそ！ ラビーが極秘ミッションのために、あなたの助けを求めている。そのミッションとは……ワンちゃんたちのビデオゲームを作ること！（ネコちゃんたちは残念ながら、今回は出番がないの）。

イギリスの田園地帯を舞台にした、手描き風の15のステージ。そこに散らばって隠れている500匹以上のワンちゃんたちやアイテムを探し出そう。行き詰まったら、犬笛を吹いてみて！子犬たちを見つけ出すたびに地図は広がり、飛行機やボート、電車なども登場するよ！

ゲームの特徴：
- 500匹以上の犬とアイテムを探し出そう
- 丁寧に描かれた15のステージ
- それぞれに悩みを抱えた4匹のワンちゃんたちの物語
- オリジナルサウンドトラック

releases.name: Forever Ago
releases.summary:
Following a tragic stroke of fate, Alfred embarks on a journey north in search of redemption. In this single-player road trip adventure, you'll travel to beautiful places, capture memories with your camera, meet interesting characters, and even make some new friends.

Experience a nuanced and heartfelt story about broken dreams, loss, and regret - but also courage, hope, and true friendship. Learn about the stories, beliefs and struggles of characters you meet along the way, brought to life by renowned voice actors.

Explore beautiful environments, ranging from serene forest trails to dusty barrens sweltering in the desert sun. Examine and interact with objects to learn about your surroundings and the people living there. 

Play through a lifetime of love as Alfred with your sweetheart Audrey, experiencing a true love that transcends time.

releases.name: DAVE THE DIVER: Complete Edition
releases.summary:
Complete Edition contains:
- Dave the Diver
- In the Jungle DLC
- Dredge DLC
- Godzilla DLC
- Ichiban's Holiday DLC
- Digital Soundtrack
- Digital Artbook

DAVE THE DIVER is a casual, single player adventure RPG featuring deep-sea exploration and fishing during the day and sushi restaurant management at night. Join Dave and his quirky friends as they seek to uncover the secrets of the mysterious Blue Hole.

releases.name: Ripple Island
releases.summary:
"Ripple Island" was released by SUNSOFT in 1988 for an 8 -bit home console.
This is an adventure game in which the player takes on the role of the protagonist Kyle and goes on an adventure while operating 9 types of commands. Whether you can rescue Princess Nasareru, who was kidnapped by a monster calling himself Emperor Groaker, bring peace back to Ripple Island, and be united with the heroine depends on your judgment and actions.

releases.name: Dreadway
releases.summary:
A co-op horror about surviving a nuclear apocalypse as a small group of people on a train, scavenging for various scrap to upgrade the train.

Explore the post-apocalyptic world with your friends in search of bunkers, limited to a specific location in this game.

Delve deep into bunkers, scavenging for essential resources, crafting materials, and useful items like the limited selection of flashlights or crowbars found.

The train constantly requires fuel - burn items you collect to keep it running, or risk losing everything. Remember, every resource counts!

releases.name: I'm Having A Bad Day
releases.summary:
Created as a compact and physical VR experience, I’m Having a Bad Day is a cartoon-style game built around a simple idea: breaking things can be fun.

You play as a contestant in a fictional reality show set across different environments. The goal is simple: smash, dismantle, and create as much controlled chaos as possible within a short time limit.

Objects react with exaggerated cartoon physics and clear visual feedback. Power-ups, such as oversized tools or jelly weapons, temporarily shift the pace and encourage different approaches to destruction.

I’m Having a Bad Day is a straightforward, physics-driven VR game built around short bursts of action and repeatable levels, created for players who enjoy quick sessions and physical interaction in virtual space.
